newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait wants 2.5 mln bpd oil quota in 2000.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait wants 2.5 mln bpd oil quota in 2000.

text.p: Oil Minister Abdul-Mohsen al-Mudej said on Tuesday Kuwait wants a production quota of 2.5 million barrels per day (bpd) in the year 2000 and three million in the year 2005, state-owned Kuwait News Agency said.
Kuwait "plans to make the production quota reach 2.5 million bpd in the year 2000 and three million bpd in the year 2005," the agency quoted Mudej as telling a news conference.
Kuwait's current production quota is set by the Organisation of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) at two million bpd.
Mudej has said in the past said Kuwait wants to increase its OPEC quota by 200,000 bpd in the event that the organisation decides to raise its overall production ceiling.
Mudej, reiterating previous statements, added that Kuwait wants to increase its crude oil production capacity to three million bpd in the year 2000 and to 3.5 million bpd in the year 2005.
